Warn.WrongSystem: Ten Candles – Table requires the “Ten Candles – Game Assistant” system.

Ritual.WorldIsDark: These things are true. The world is dark.

Concepts.Title: Module & concepts
Concepts.Ask: Ask the players to work out a concept for their characters and introduce them to the group:
Concepts.Name: Name: what are they called?
Concepts.Look: Look: what do they look like at a quick glance?
Concepts.Concept: Concept: in a few words, who or what are they?
Concepts.Module: First introduce the module: read out tonight's setting and situation, like a mission briefing.

Arrange.Title: Stacks & supplies
Arrange.Ask: Ask the players to arrange their stack in the character sheet (drag a card):
Arrange.Order: Virtue, Vice and Moment in any order. Only the top card is active.
Arrange.Brink: The Brink always lies at the bottom.
Arrange.Moments: Ideally no more than one Moment on top within the group.
Arrange.Then: Then: “{button}”. From then on the order is fixed.
Arrange.Supplies: Supplies: each character has whatever their player has in their pockets right now. Anything more only through truths or conflicts.

Begins.Title: It begins
Begins.Ask: If you like, read the module once more and set the first scene.
Begins.Then: Then: “{button}”. Each character leaves a final message; after that the first scene begins.

GM.DeathsHint: Mark whose character has died (and whether as a Martyr). The dead no longer roll or speak truths.
GM.StepBackHint: Back to the previous step of character creation. Every card stays written; what that step passed on is passed on again.
GM.DraughtHint: A draught snuffs the next candle: the scene ends as after a failed conflict. Only you see this button.
GM.DraughtBlocked: No candle can be put out during a conflict or the truths. Press “Draught” again afterwards.
GM.ClockWaiting: The candles burn down from “Lights out”.
GM.RecorderSkipHint: Passes the recorder on without a message, e.g. when someone cannot record.
GM.AliveHint: Shows everyone the last truth, spoken by all players together. Then the next scene begins.
GM.RecorderRestartHint: The recorder goes round once more. Whoever has a message already may keep it or record a new one.
GM.ReplayHint: Plays the last message once more for everyone, e.g. when it did not play somewhere.

PlainTable.Name: Plain table
PlainTable.Hint: Shows Foundry's normal scene and camera dock instead of the candle table. Writing cards, the recorder and the X-card keep working. For weak computers or when something doesn't work.

Write.TraitsHint: One good and one bad trait – any trait will do, not only a virtue or vice in the strict sense. One word or a short phrase each.
Write.VirtueExamples: Examples: Lucky, Resourceful, Watchful, Merciful, Daring, Committed, Handsome, Hardy, Subtle, Streetwise, Strong.
Write.ViceExamples: Examples: Afraid, Greedy, Regretful, Addicted, Naive, Controlling, Worrisome, Compulsive, Claustrophobic, Rash.
Write.MomentHint: A moment in which your character could find hope. This card stays with you.
Write.BrinkHint: For {name}: what you have seen of them. The card goes face down to your left.
Write.BrinkByThemHint: For {name}: what THEY have seen of them. The card goes face down to your left.
Write.BrinkOfThemHint: What you have seen of THEM. The card goes face down to the GM.
Write.BrinkExamples:
Examples: Kill, Abandon, Rage, Lie, Hide, Cry, Sacrifice, Betray, Freeze, Promise, Collapse, Fight, Run.
“I have seen you destroy what you care about most. I saw you on trial, before the world went dark. Three dead. Your family. You monster.”
“I have seen you break down. While we were on the run, you lost it over this dead dog. You cried for hours. I almost left you behind.”
“I have seen you worship Them. You didn’t see me, but I saw you. Whispering prayers for Them to spare your life. I saw Them give you something, but couldn’t make out what it was.”
Write.BrinkByThemExamples: Examples: Kill, Abandon, Rage, Lie, Hide, Cry, Sacrifice, Betray, Freeze, Promise, Collapse, Fight, Run.
Write.BrinkOfThemExamples:
Examples:
“… move like shadows.”
“… shapeshift in front of me.”
“… howl at the pale moon.”
“… consume the dead.”
“… possess the living.”
“… and I know this is all an experiment.”
“… and They serve the witch of the woods.”
“… and They are the gods made manifest.”
Write.NoGM: The GM is not connected – your card has not been handed in yet. Open it again later and press “Done”.
Write.NotStored: Your card did not reach the GM. Open it again and press “Done”.
Write.TooLate: The cards were already on their way – your change came too late.
Write.TooLong: This card is too long (at most {max} characters). Open it again and shorten it.

XCard.Touched: Someone touched the X-card. We drop that and move on.

Recorder.Hint: You hold the recorder. Leave one last message as your character.
Recorder.Recorded: Recorded. Listen, record again or pass it on.
Recorder.PassFailed: Passing it on did not work. Your recording is still here – please try again.
Recorder.NoMicrophone: No microphone available. Please allow the browser to use the microphone.
Recorder.NoGM: The GM is not connected – the recorder cannot be passed on right now.
Recorder.UploadFailed: A recording could not be stored. The recorder stays with that player, who can try again.
Recorder.Kept: You left a message already. Listen to it, record a new one or keep it and pass on.
Recorder.UploadBroken: Recordings cannot be stored right now – your login has probably expired. Reload the page, log in again and then switch the recorder on.
Recorder.PlaybackFailed: This message could not be played here. The GM can play it again.
Recorder.MicrophoneGone: The chosen microphone is not available. Recording with the browser's default microphone.
Recorder.Listening: You are listening to your message.

Seats.Title: Seating
Seats.Hint: Clockwise as at a real table: you at the top, below you whoever sits on your left, and so on. Virtues go right, Vices and Brinks go left, the recorder travels left.

Death.Title: The dead
Death.Hint: Whose character has died? Martyrs may pass on their hope die. Unticking brings a character back, should it have been a slip.
Death.NoRoll: Your character has died and rolls no more. The roll was called off.
Death.NoRollFor: {name} has died and rolls no more. The roll was called off.
Death.HeirHint: {name} dies a Martyr. Who gets the hope die?
Death.TransferInStateControl: Now pass the hope die from {from} to {to} in the "Ten Candles Shared State" window: select {from}, recipient {to}, "Transfer".

Moment.Question: Does the situation fit the Moment?
Moment.Rolling: The roll decides: success brings hope.
Moment.Unfit: Doesn't fit right now. The Moment stays in the stack.
Moment.NotNow: No roll can start right now: only in a scene with dice and no open conflict.
Moment.RollDidNotStart: The roll for the Moment did not start. Decide again.
Moment.PlayerAway: {name} is not connected. The roll for the Moment cannot start right now.
Moment.NotSettled: {name}'s Moment could not be settled yet. It is tried again with the next change in the game.

Truths.Title: Establishing truths
Truths.Opening: These things are true. The world is dark.
Truths.NoRoll: Nobody rolls while the truths are spoken. The roll was called off.

Sheet.PositionHint: Place in the stack: only the top card is active. Drag a card to change the order.
Sheet.TraitUsedThisScene: A Virtue or Vice was already used in this scene – the other one only in the next scene.
